items.title: AI闖大禍誰買單？Anthropic拚2兆美元估值 投資人難算這筆帳
items.title_en: Who Pays the Price When AI Goes Wrong? Anthropic Aims for $2 Trillion Valuation, Investors Unsure How to Account for the Cost
paras: Anthropic籌備大型首次公開發行(IPO)，估值可能高達2兆美元，但潛在投資人面臨一道難題：如果AI失控造成重大損害，甚至威脅人類生存，這種難以量化的風險該如何反映在股價上？
據《彭博》報導，部分研究人員在社群平台X討論AI導致人類滅絕的機率可能達10%以上，引發爭論。Anthropic共同創辦人暨執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)也撰文警告，若開發腳步未放緩，人類可能失去對AI的控制，技術也可能被用於網路攻擊、生物恐怖主義，或造成嚴重經濟衝擊。

潛在賠償難估算 投資人未必反映在估值

創投機構Slow Ventures合夥人雷辛(Sam Lessin)主張，美國政府應要求AI實驗室提存1兆美元現金，支應未來可能造成的損害，類似金融危機後要求銀行增加資本緩衝。
他認為，即使不計人類滅絕情境，AI對社會造成的潛在負擔也可能達2兆至4兆美元，甚至讓公司的整體價值低於零。但部分投資人仍可能買進，因為預期最終會由其他人埋單。Anthropic對此不予置評。
這類疑慮尚未明顯澆熄市場熱情。SpaceX(SPCX-US)旗下Grok同樣參與AI競爭，其上市文件揭露錯誤資訊與AI欺騙等風險，卻未提及生存威脅。該公司6月IPO募得862億美元，目前股價仍較發行價高出逾20%；Anthropic則計畫募集相當或更高金額。
Private Shares Fund投資組合經理人莫斯(Kevin Moss)認為，AI確實需要監管架構，但安全辯論不太可能打亂Anthropic上市計畫。川普政府雖表達關切，也同時重視鬆綁監管與對中競爭。

安全投入可能成優勢 保險仍難承擔所有損失

川普近期與包括阿莫戴在內的科技領袖達成具有「道德約束力」的AI安全協議，緩和部分投資人焦慮。不過，降低風險的責任目前主要仍由企業承擔。
PitchBook分析師羅爾夫斯(Harrison Rolfes)指出，安全機制會增加成本，但也可能提升客戶信任；若中國或開源競爭者無法達到相同標準，反而可形成競爭優勢。
保險則未必能完全保護股東。英國石油(BP-US)2010年深水地平線事故造成11人死亡，其自保安排額度僅7億美元，最終事故成本卻高達數百億美元。
Relm Insurance執行長齊奧爾科夫斯基(Joe Ziolkowski)表示，AI缺乏歷史理賠數據，責任歸屬也不明確，使企業取得保障面臨挑戰。隨AI從提供資訊走向自主決策、與其他代理互動，損失由誰負責愈加迫切。
他認為，投資人不太可能為無法量化的風險調降IPO估值。因此，在這些風險能被客觀估算之前，反而是企業籌資的有利時機。
paras_en: Anthropic is preparing for a large initial public offering (IPO) that could value the company at up to $2 trillion, but potential investors face a dilemma: how should the price reflect the hard‑to‑quantify risk that AI could cause catastrophic damage or even threaten human survival?

According to Bloomberg, some researchers on the social platform X discussed that the probability of AI causing human extinction could be over 10%, sparking controversy. Anthropic co‑founder and CEO Dario Amodei warned that if development does not slow, humanity could lose control of AI, which could be used for cyber attacks, bioterrorism, or cause severe economic shocks.

Estimating potential compensation is difficult, and investors may not reflect it in the valuation. Sam Lessin, partner at venture firm Slow Ventures, argues that the U.S. government should require AI labs to set aside $1 trillion in cash to cover future damages, similar to the capital buffers banks were required to hold after the financial crisis.

He believes that even without considering human extinction scenarios, the potential societal burden of AI could reach $2–4 trillion, possibly making the company’s overall value negative. Yet some investors may still buy, expecting that others will ultimately foot the bill. Anthropic has not commented on this.

These concerns have not dampened market enthusiasm. SpaceX’s Grok, also competing in AI, disclosed risks of misinformation and AI deception in its filing but did not mention existential threats. The company raised $86.2 billion in its June IPO, and its stock remains more than 20% above the issue price; Anthropic plans to raise a comparable or larger amount.

Kevin Moss, portfolio manager at Private Shares Fund, believes AI does need a regulatory framework, but the safety debate is unlikely to derail Anthropic’s IPO plans. The Trump administration, while expressing concerns, also emphasizes deregulation and competition with China.

Investing in safety could become an advantage, but insurance still cannot cover all losses. The Trump administration recently reached a “morally binding” AI safety agreement with tech leaders including Amodei, easing some investor anxiety. However, the responsibility for reducing risk remains largely on the companies.

PitchBook analyst Harrison Rolfes notes that safety mechanisms will increase costs but may also boost customer trust; if Chinese or open‑source competitors cannot meet the same standards, it could become a competitive advantage.

Insurance may not fully protect shareholders. BP’s 2010 Deepwater Horizon incident killed 11 people, and its self‑insurance limit was only $700 million, while the final cost of the incident ran into the hundreds of billions.

Joe Ziolkowski, CEO of Relm Insurance, says AI lacks historical claims data and liability is unclear, making it challenging for companies to obtain coverage. As AI moves from providing information to autonomous decision‑making and interacting with other agents, the question of who bears the loss becomes more urgent.

He believes investors are unlikely to lower IPO valuations for unquantifiable risks. Therefore, until these risks can be objectively estimated, it may actually be a favorable time for companies to raise capital.

items.title: 特納斯接棒就遇硬仗！iPhone 18 Pro美國買氣弱 Duo又傳生產卡關
items.title_en: Ternus Faces a Tough Start: Weak US Demand for iPhone 18 Pro and Duo Production Hiccups Reported
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)迎來上任後的重要考驗：高階iPhone 18 Pro系列在美國的初期需求偏弱，iPhone Duo又傳出量產困難，可能影響上市時程。不過，Bernstein分析師認為，既有iPhone 17銷售仍強勁，中國與印度的新機買氣也有支撐，因此維持蘋果「優於大盤」評等。
Bernstein科技分析師紐曼(Mark Newman)日前發布報告指出，8月全球iPhone銷量年增7%，連續18個月較去年同期成長，但增幅較7月的14%放緩。受平均售價上升6%帶動，營收年增13%，顯示售價提高仍有助於支撐銷售金額。

美國新機買氣偏弱 中印市場表現較強

紐曼表示，相較iPhone 17系列，市場對iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max的初期反應不一。美國兩款新機需求較去年同期呈低個位數百分比下滑，其中Pro等待交貨時間縮短，Pro Max則拉長，反映不同機型的供需情況仍有差異。
中國市場相對亮眼，新款Pro系列首周銷量年增12%；印度上市前三天銷量則增加19%。日本、南韓與阿拉伯聯合大公國的初期需求較疲弱，顯示這波換機潮在各地呈現兩樣情。
既有iPhone 17系列仍展現韌性。截至8月的12個月內，該系列累計售出約1.74億支，比上一代機型上市後相同期間高出約18%。
不過，紐曼指出，截至8月，蘋果會計年度第四季的出貨進度略落後歷史水準。7、8月合計出貨3,300萬支，相當於市場預估單季5,820萬支的57%，低於歷史平均的60%。

Duo傳生產挑戰 基本款延至明春牽動出貨

產品上市節奏也是影響短期需求的重要因素。基本款iPhone 18延至2027年春季推出，意味今年新機銷售更倚重高階機型；在晶片短缺推高手機價格之際，也可能讓部分消費者延後購機，等待明年價格較低的基本款上市。
《MacRumors》另報導，iPhone Duo面臨生產問題，可能延後上市。不過，紐曼的報告仍以10月16日開放預購、10月23日出貨為預期時程，並看好美國市場需求，指出早期上手評價大致正面。
根據紐曼引述的Counterpoint估計，若供應充足，iPhone Duo在2026年可望售出約600萬支。因此，實際供貨能力將是這款新機能否將市場興趣轉化為銷量的關鍵。
對供應鏈而言，Duo較晚出貨，加上基本款iPhone 18延後登場，已壓抑大立光(3008-TW)等蘋果供應商的短期需求。

Bernstein維持看多 等待2027年新品接棒

儘管新機初期買氣有強有弱，紐曼仍認為，蘋果供應鏈整體表現優於Android陣營。2027年上半年的基本款iPhone 18，以及下半年的iPhone問世20周年產品線，可望持續支撐投資人信心與估值。
他因此維持蘋果「優於大盤」評等，12個月目標價為370美元。相較之下，《彭博》追蹤的華爾街分析師平均目標價約334美元，約58%給予「買進」評等、30%為「中立」，另有六名分析師建議「賣出」。
Jefferies(JEF-US)與美國銀行(BAC-US)分析師也注意到，iPhone 18在部分主要市場需求偏弱。晶片短缺推升售價、消費者負擔能力，以及新品上市時間錯開，將共同考驗蘋果這一輪產品周期的成長力道。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) new CEO John Ternus faces a crucial early test: the high‑end iPhone 18 Pro series shows soft initial demand in the United States, and the iPhone Duo is rumored to be hitting production snags that could delay its launch. Bernstein analysts, however, note that iPhone 17 sales remain strong and that demand in China and India provides support, so they keep Apple’s “outperform” rating.

Bernstein tech analyst Mark Newman recently reported that global iPhone shipments grew 7% year‑over‑year in August, marking 18 consecutive months of growth, though the pace slowed from July’s 14% gain. Revenue rose 13% year‑over‑year, driven by a 6% rise in average selling price, showing that higher prices still help lift sales value.

US demand for the new models is weak while China and India perform better. Newman said that compared with the iPhone 17 line, the market’s early reaction to the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max is mixed. In the US, demand for both models fell by low‑single‑digit percentages versus a year ago, with the Pro’s delivery window shortening and the Pro Max’s lengthening, reflecting differing supply‑demand dynamics for each variant.

China’s market looks brighter, with the new Pro series posting a 12% year‑over‑year increase in sales during its first week, while India saw a 19% jump in the first three days. Japan, South Korea and the United Arab Emirates showed weaker early demand, indicating a split pattern in this upgrade cycle across regions.

The existing iPhone 17 series still shows resilience. Over the 12‑month period ending in August, the line sold about 174 million units, roughly 18% more than the same period after the previous generation launched.

However, Newman pointed out that Apple’s fiscal fourth‑quarter shipment pace was slightly below historical norms as of August. Shipments in July and August combined to 33 million units, about 57% of the market’s single‑quarter estimate of 58.2 million, shy of the 60% historical average.

Duo production challenges and a delayed launch of the base‑model iPhone 18 push shipments into spring 2027, making short‑term demand more dependent on the high‑end models. With chip shortages inflating flagship prices, some consumers may postpone purchases, waiting for a lower‑priced base model next year.

MacRumors also reported that the iPhone Duo faces production issues that could push back its launch. Nonetheless, Newman’s report still expects pre‑orders to open on October 16 and shipments to begin on October 23, and he remains optimistic about US demand, noting generally positive early user feedback.

According to Counterpoint estimates cited by Newman, if supply is ample, the iPhone Duo could sell about 6 million units in 2026. Thus, actual supply capacity will be critical to converting market interest into sales for the new device.
For the supply chain, the Duo’s later launch combined with the postponed base‑model iPhone 18 release has already dampened short‑term demand for Apple suppliers such as Largan Precision (3008‑TW).

Bernstein remains bullish, waiting for the 2027 product wave. Despite mixed early demand, Newman still believes Apple’s supply chain outperforms the Android camp overall. The standard‑model iPhone 18 slated for early 2027 and the 20th‑anniversary iPhone line later that year should continue to support investor confidence and valuation.

Accordingly, Bernstein maintains its “outperform” rating with a 12‑month target price of $370. By comparison, Bloomberg‑tracked Wall Street analysts have an average target of about $334, with roughly 58% rating “buy,” 30% “neutral,” and six analysts recommending “sell.”

Jefferies (JEF‑US) and Bank of America (BAC‑US) analysts also note that iPhone 18 demand is soft in some key markets. Chip shortages driving up prices, consumer affordability constraints, and staggered launch timing will together test the growth strength of Apple’s current product cycle.

items.title: 美債跌夠了？有人先進場抄底 押注長債反彈
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Have Fallen Enough? Some Jump In to Bottom‑Fish, Betting on a Long‑Bond Rebound
paras: 美債持續遭拋售之際，部分選擇權交易員開始押注跌勢接近尾聲。iShares 20年期以上美國公債ETF(TLT-US)本周三買權交易明顯升溫，加上10年期美債標售需求強勁，顯示市場已有資金布局債券反彈，但能否止跌仍待後續需求驗證。
根據Cboe LiveVol與SpotGamma彙整數據，TLT當天選擇權成交量較30日平均高出50%，交易員買進近37萬口買權，買進賣權則不到10萬口，同時賣出賣權的數量超過買進。
成交最熱絡的十大合約中，九檔為買權。雖然也有賣出買權交易，但整體成交量與權利金流向偏向看漲，暗示部分交易員認為，繼續押注殖利率上升的風險報酬已不具吸引力。TLT持有長天期美債，價格回升通常意味殖利率下降。
其中，10月30日到期、履約價82美元的買權最受矚目，合約報價約0.10美元，成交約1.6萬口。要讓這筆押注奏效，TLT須收復9月22日以來約6%的跌幅；這段猛烈賣壓曾將30年期美債殖利率推升至5.6%以上。
主要買盤來自美東時間上午10時01分進場的一名積極買家，至少投入25萬美元，買進不同到期日、履約價80與82美元的買權。交易金額雖非特別龐大，卻是當天月底到期合約中最大買盤，且發生在帶動債市反彈的10年期美債標售之前。
Perry International Capital Partners投資長佩里(Jim Perry)形容，10年期美債買盤強勁，投資人展現願意直接按市價承接的態度。下一道考驗則是周四(8日)美東下午1時的30年期美債標售。
利率敏感的公用事業股也出現類似訊號。公用事業類股ETF(XLU-US)上周五出現約100萬美元賣權賣出交易，押注跌勢趨緩或反轉，該類股此後上漲約3%。
佩里認為，殖利率可能接近高點，但他更偏好股票，因為若殖利率回落，股市表現可能優於債市。
paras_en: As U.S. Treasuries continue to be sold off, some options traders are beginning to bet that the downtrend is nearing its end. The iShares 20‑Year+ Treasury Bond ETF (TLT‑US) saw a noticeable rise in call buying on Wednesday, and strong demand for the 10‑year Treasury auction suggests that market participants are already positioning for a bond rally, though whether the decline can be halted still depends on subsequent demand.

According to data compiled by Cboe LiveVol and SpotGamma, TLT options volume that day was about 50% higher than the 30‑day average, with traders buying roughly 370,000 call contracts while buying fewer than 100,000 puts, and the amount of puts sold exceeding the amount bought.

Among the ten most actively traded contracts, nine were calls. Although there were some put‑selling trades, overall volume and premium flow leaned bullish, indicating that some traders believe the risk‑reward of betting on further yield rises is no longer attractive. Holding long‑dated Treasuries, a price rise for TLT typically means yields are falling.

The most watched contract was the October 30 call with an $82 strike, priced around $0.10 and trading about 16,000 contracts. For this bet to pay off, TLT would need to recover roughly 6% of its drop since September 22, a slump that had pushed the 30‑year Treasury yield above 5.6%.

The main buying came from an aggressive buyer who entered at 10:01 a.m. Eastern Time, committing at least $250,000 to calls with $80 and $82 strikes across different expirations. Though the trade size wasn’t huge, it was the largest buy in the contracts expiring at month‑end that day, and it occurred before the 10‑year Treasury auction that sparked the bond‑market rebound.

Perry International Capital Partners’ chief investment officer Jim Perry described the 10‑year Treasury buying as strong, with investors showing a willingness to take on the bonds at market price. The next test will be the 30‑year Treasury auction scheduled for Thursday the 8th at 1 p.m. Eastern.

Utility stocks, which are sensitive to interest rates, showed a similar signal. The utility‑sector ETF (XLU‑US) saw about $1 million of put contracts sold last Friday, betting on a slowdown or reversal of the decline, and the sector subsequently rose roughly 3%.
Perry believes yields may be near their peak, but he prefers equities because if yields fall, the stock market could outperform the bond market.

items.title: 要頒獎給黃仁勳了！川普帳戶買賣輝達紀錄也曝光
items.title_en: Trump Set to Award Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang—His Nvidia Trading Records Also Unveiled
paras: 川普準備頒發美國國家科學獎章給輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳之際，最新財務申報揭露，他名下投資組合8月買進最高160萬美元輝達股票，同時賣出最高100萬美元。由於川普政府正評估可能影響輝達業務的政策，包括先進晶片出口規範，這些交易也讓總統投資與政策決策之間的關係受到關注。
據《路透》報導，這份申報文件由川普於9月17日簽署，並在周四(8日)公開。輝達股票買賣只是他名下投資組合8月數百筆交易的一部分，買進與賣出數字均為申報金額上限，並非確切成交總額。
白宮發言人英格爾(Davis Ingle)回應表示，川普的投資組合由第三方金融機構獨立管理，並追蹤嘉信1000指數等公認指數。他強調，所有投資決策完全由獨立經理人作出，不存在利益衝突。
這項揭露的時機格外受到矚目，因為川普預定同日向黃仁勳頒發國家科學獎章。輝達是全球市值最高的企業之一，其先進晶片出口受到美國政策管制，政府後續決策可能影響公司的銷售機會與營運前景。輝達發言人未立即回應置評要求。
國家科學獎章是美國表彰科學成就的最高榮譽。根據美國國家科學基金會說明，獎項旨在表揚於物理、生物、數學、工程，以及社會與行為科學等領域，對知識進展作出傑出貢獻並服務國家的美國人士。歷屆得主的研究成果涵蓋癌症偵測，以及乾旱期間維護糧食供應等領域。
除黃仁勳外，川普也預定於周四將同一獎章頒給SpaceX執行長馬斯克，以及Google共同創辦人布林(Sergey Brin)。
paras_en: As Trump prepares to present the National Medal of Science to Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang, the latest financial disclosure reveals that his portfolio bought up to $1.6 million of Nvidia shares in August while also selling up to $1 million. Because the Trump administration is reviewing policies that could affect Nvidia’s business, including advanced chip export regulations, these trades have drawn attention to the relationship between the president’s investments and policy decisions.

According to Reuters, the filing was signed by Trump on September 17 and made public on Thursday (the 8th). The Nvidia trades represent only a portion of the hundreds of transactions in his portfolio for August, and the buy and sell figures are the maximum amounts reported, not the exact transaction totals.

White House spokesperson Davis Ingle responded that Trump’s portfolio is independently managed by a third‑party financial firm and tracks recognized indices such as the Charles Schwab 1000. He emphasized that all investment decisions are made by independent managers, with no conflict of interest.

The timing of the disclosure is especially noteworthy because Trump is scheduled to award the medal to Huang on the same day. Nvidia is one of the world’s most valuable companies, and its advanced chip exports are subject to U.S. policy controls; subsequent government decisions could affect the company’s sales opportunities and operating outlook. Nvidia’s spokesperson did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

The National Medal of Science is the United States’ highest honor for scientific achievement. According to the National Science Foundation, the award recognizes U.S. individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the advancement of knowledge and service to the nation in fields such as physics, biology, mathematics, engineering, and the social and behavioral sciences. Past recipients have been honored for work ranging from cancer detection to safeguarding food supplies during droughts.
In addition to Huang, Trump is also slated to present the same medal on Thursday to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Google co‑founder Sergey Brin.

items.title: 科技巨頭名校一起查！川普政府限微軟辦員工綠卡 留美實習擬每人收7萬美元
items.title_en: Tech Giants and Elite Universities Under Investigation: Trump Administration Bars Microsoft from Employee Green Card Program, Proposes $70,000 Fee per International Student for OPT
paras: 川普政府擴大打擊其所稱的外籍人才與學生簽證濫用，接連對科技企業、大學及留學生實習制度採取行動。副總統范斯周四(8日)宣布，暫停微軟(MSFT-US)等企業參與一項協助外籍員工申請綠卡的計畫，並調查九所大學使用J-1簽證的情況；國土安全部另提出新規，擬要求學校為每名首次申請選擇性實習訓練(OPT)的外籍學生支付7萬美元。
這三項措施分別涉及企業聘用外籍人才、學術交流與留學生工作機會。其中，企業面臨的是綠卡申請程序限制，並非全面禁止使用H-1B工作簽證；OPT收費則仍屬提案，尚未正式生效。

微軟與多家科技業者遭限制 政府指控排擠美國勞工

綜合外媒報導，范斯指控微軟濫用外籍人才制度，宣布暫停該公司參與永久勞工認證計畫(PERM)。這項程序通常是雇主替外籍員工申請就業類綠卡的重要前置步驟，要求企業證明沒有合適且願意接受職缺的美國勞工。
范斯在白宮記者會上宣稱，微軟每裁減一名員工，就以約1.5名外籍員工取代，並以「外籍契約僕役」形容這些勞工。這是政府提出的指控，微軟未立即回應置評要求。
勞工部長桑德林(Keith Sonderling)表示，其他遭暫停參與計畫的企業，包括Adobe(ADBE-US)、Cognizant(CTSH-US)、Infosys(INFY-US)與Wipro(WIT-US)等大型科技及資訊服務業者。

九所大學遭查J-1簽證 勞工部成立反詐欺專案小組

大學方面，政府將調查哈佛、耶魯、史丹佛、布朗、匹茲堡大學、加州大學戴維斯分校、加州理工學院、亞利桑那州立大學及麻省理工學院，共九所學校。
范斯指控，這些大學過度使用J-1交流訪客簽證，引進成本較低的外籍學生與研究人員，壓低美國研究生及研究人員的薪資。勞工部正成立簽證詐欺專案小組，並已向相關學校發出傳票。
勞工部監察長德斯波西托(Anthony D’Esposito)表示，美國納稅人每年投入數十億美元支持大學研究與創新，有權知道資金流向及使用是否合法。目前相關事項仍在調查階段，並不代表遭點名學校已被認定違法。

OPT擬收7萬美元首申費 教育界憂人才卻步

另一路政策攻勢則指向持F-1學生簽證者使用的OPT制度。國土安全部日前宣布提案，擬要求大專院校為每名首次參與OPT的外籍學生支付7萬美元，後續OPT申請或延長授權則須支付3萬美元。提案目前仍在規則制定程序中。
OPT允許外籍學生在學期間或畢業後，從事與所學領域相關的工作。學生須先取得校方指定人員推薦，再向美國公民及移民服務局申請工作許可。一般畢業後OPT期間為一年，符合資格的科學、科技、工程與數學(STEM)領域畢業生，可再延長兩年。
根據高等教育與移民校長聯盟資料，2024至2025學年度有逾29.4萬名外籍學生參與OPT。
國土安全部表示，提案是為回應學生與交流訪客計畫所發現的詐欺及濫用，包括不當工作場所與「付費維持居留」安排。政府認為，收費可促使學校加強監督，更審慎推薦學生參與。
不過，國際教育工作者協會NAFSA執行長奧(Fanta Aw)反駁，OPT讓外籍學生取得實務經驗，也協助填補STEM領域人力缺口。她警告，新收費制度將加深留學生的不確定性，若把國際人才拒於門外，將傷害美國創新、經濟成長與全球領導地位。

學生簽證限制接連涉訟 政策推進仍受司法檢驗

這項收費提案推出前，川普政府另一項F-1限制已遭法院暫時阻擋。該規定原擬要求學生在美停留滿四年後，須另行申請批准才能延長居留。
麻州聯邦地方法院法官塞勒四世(F. Dennis Saylor IV)於9月14日阻止規定在訴訟期間實施，認為國土安全部未說明，這項限制如何防範未來的間諜活動或破壞行為。
政府也曾於2025年5月試圖撤銷哈佛招收國際學生的資格，但哈佛提告後，聯邦法院阻止政府執行。隨著新一波調查與收費提案展開，企業用人需求、大學國際招生與政府保護本國勞工的政策目標，將持續面臨衝突與司法檢驗。
paras_en: The Trump administration is expanding its crackdown on what it calls abuse of foreign talent and student visas, taking successive actions against tech companies, universities and the internship system for international students. Vice President Fans announced on Thursday (the 8th) a suspension of Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and other firms from a program that helps foreign employees apply for green cards, and an investigation of nine universities’ use of J‑1 visas; the Department of Homeland Security also proposed a new rule that would require schools to pay $70,000 for each foreign student’s first Optional Practical Training (OPT) application.

These three measures each target corporate hiring of foreign talent, academic exchange and work opportunities for international students. The corporate impact is a restriction on the green‑card application process, not a blanket ban on H‑1B work visas; the OPT fee remains a proposal and has not yet taken effect.

Microsoft and several other tech firms are being restricted, with the government accusing them of crowding out American workers. According to foreign media reports, Fans accused Microsoft of abusing the foreign‑talent system and announced a pause on the company’s participation in the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) program. This procedure is normally a key pre‑step where employers petition for employment‑based green cards for foreign workers, requiring proof that no suitable U.S. worker is available for the position.

Fans told reporters at the White House that for every Microsoft employee laid off, the company replaces them with roughly 1.5 foreign workers, describing them as “foreign contract servants.” These are government allegations; Microsoft did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said other firms suspended from the program include Adobe (ADBE‑US), Cognizant (CTSH‑US), Infosys (INFY‑US) and Wipro (WIT‑US), among other large technology and information‑services companies.

Nine universities are being investigated for J‑1 visa use, with the Labor Department forming an anti‑fraud task force. The schools under scrutiny are Harvard, Yale, Stanford, Brown, the University of Pittsburgh, UC Davis, Caltech, Arizona State University and MIT.

Fans alleges these universities overuse J‑1 exchange visitor visas to bring in lower‑cost foreign students and researchers, suppressing salaries for U.S. graduate students and researchers. The Labor Department is creating a visa‑fraud task force and has already issued subpoenas to the institutions involved.

Anthony D’Esposito, the Labor Department’s chief watchdog, said U.S. taxpayers invest billions of dollars each year in university research and innovation and have a right to know whether the funds are being used legally. The matters are still under investigation and do not imply that the named schools have been found to have broken the law.

Another policy thrust targets the OPT system used by F‑1 visa holders. The Department of Homeland Security recently announced a proposal to require colleges to pay $70,000 for each foreign student’s first OPT participation, with a later $30,000 fee for subsequent OPT applications or extensions. The proposal is still in the rule‑making process.

OPT allows foreign students to work in jobs related to their field of study during school or after graduation. Students must first obtain a recommendation from a designated school official and then apply to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services for work authorization. The standard post‑graduation OPT period is one year, with an additional two‑year extension available to qualified STEM graduates.
According to data from the Alliance of Higher Education and Immigration Leaders, more than 294,000 foreign students participated in OPT for the 2024‑2025 academic year.

The Department of Homeland Security says the proposal is meant to address fraud and abuse uncovered in student and exchange‑visitor programs, including improper workplaces and “pay‑to‑stay” arrangements. The government believes a fee would encourage schools to monitor more closely and be more cautious in recommending students for participation.

However, Fanta Aw, CEO of the international education association NAFSA, countered that OPT provides foreign students with practical experience and helps fill labor gaps in STEM fields. She warned that the new fee structure would increase uncertainty for international students and, by shutting out global talent, would harm U.S. innovation, economic growth and global leadership.

Student‑visa restrictions have already faced litigation, and the policy rollout remains subject to judicial review. Before this fee proposal, another Trump‑era F‑1 restriction was temporarily blocked by a court. That rule would have required students who have stayed in the U.S. for four years to obtain separate approval to extend their stay.

U.S. District Judge F. Dennis Saylor IV of the Massachusetts federal court halted the rule on September 14, finding that the Department of Homeland Security had not explained how the restriction would prevent future espionage or sabotage.

The government also tried in May 2025 to strip Harvard of its ability to admit international students, but a federal court blocked enforcement after Harvard sued. As new investigations and fee proposals move forward, tensions among corporate hiring needs, university international enrollment and government efforts to protect domestic labor will continue to be tested in the courts.

items.title: 川普喊話期中選舉前不打伊朗！國際油價短線急挫 美債殖利率回落
items.title_en: Trump Says No Attack on Iran Before Midterms; International Oil Prices Plunge, US Treasury Yields Fall
paras: 美國總統川普周四(8日)在社群平台Truth Social發文表示，美方正與伊朗進行「富有成效的討論」，並明確宣布，在美國11月3日期中選舉之前，不會對伊朗發動攻擊。不過他強調，對伊朗的封鎖將維持全面生效，並重申伊朗不得擁有核武。消息傳出後，國際油價短線急挫，美債殖利率同步回落，現貨黃金則走高。
川普在貼文中聲稱，伊朗目前的經濟與軍事情勢都相當糟糕，但美方仍持續與德黑蘭對話。他表示，希望讓所有人清楚了解，美國不會在期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，為選前的軍事行動劃出明確界線。
能源運輸方面，川普宣稱，荷姆茲海峽石油通行量創下紀錄，光是前一晚就有2,200萬桶石油通過，而且沒有任何一桶來自伊朗或運往伊朗。他藉此強調，海峽石油運輸與持續封鎖伊朗可以同時進行，但貼文未提供相關數據來源。
這項表態意味，美方在維持封鎖與核議題施壓的同時，仍保留外交協商空間。不過，川普並未公布談判內容、達成協議的時間表，或解除封鎖的條件，也未說明期中選舉後將採取何種行動。
川普最後以全大寫文字重申：「伊朗不會擁有核武！」顯示核問題仍是美方對伊朗政策的核心立場。
消息傳出後，10年期美債殖利率短線下挫超3個基點刷新日低至5.24%、兩年期美債殖利率從4.8%附近回撤至4.78%下方、30年期美債殖利率跌穿5.62%刷新日低。
西德州原油期貨5分鐘內下跌2.1美元/桶，報90.44美元/桶；布蘭特原油期貨5分鐘內下跌1.75美元/桶，報103.71美元/桶；現貨黃金5分鐘內上漲10.81美元/盎司，報4,121.99美元/盎司。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on his Truth Social platform on Thursday (the 8th) that the United States is having “productive discussions” with Iran and explicitly announced that it will not launch an attack on Iran before the U.S. midterm elections on November 3. He stressed, however, that the comprehensive sanctions on Iran will remain fully in effect and reiterated that Iran must not acquire nuclear weapons. After the announcement, international oil prices fell sharply in the short term, U.S. Treasury yields retreated, and spot gold rose.

In his post, Trump claimed that Iran’s economic and military situation is currently very poor, yet the United States continues to engage in dialogue with Tehran. He said he wants everyone to understand clearly that the United States will not attack Iran before the midterms, drawing a firm line around any pre‑election military action.

Regarding energy transport, Trump asserted that oil flow through the Hormuz Strait hit a record level, with 22 million barrels passing through in the previous night alone, and that none of those barrels originated from or were destined for Iran. He used this to emphasize that oil shipments through the strait can continue while the sanctions on Iran remain in place, although he provided no source for the figures.

This statement indicates that while the United States maintains the sanctions and pressure on Iran’s nuclear program, it still leaves room for diplomatic negotiations. Trump did not disclose the content of the talks, any timeline for an agreement, the conditions for lifting the sanctions, or what actions might follow after the midterms.
Trump closed his message in all‑caps, reiterating: “IRAN WILL NOT HAVE NUCLEAR WEAPONS!” underscoring that the nuclear issue remains the core of the U.S. policy toward Iran.

Following the news, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield slipped more than 3 basis points to a daily low of 5.24%, the two‑year yield fell from around 4.8% to just below 4.78%, and the 30‑year yield dropped below 5.62%, also hitting a daily low.

West Texas Intermediate crude futures fell $2.10 per barrel in five minutes to $90.44 per barrel, Brent crude futures dropped $1.75 per barrel to $103.71 per barrel, and spot gold rose $10.81 per ounce in five minutes to $4,121.99 per ounce.

items.title: AI液冷組件需求訂單激增 榮惠9月、Q3營收雙創新高本季展望樂觀
items.title_en: AI Liquid‑Cooling Component Demand Surges, Rong Hui September and Q3 Revenue Reach New Highs, Outlook Optimistic
paras: AI液冷及PCB供應商榮惠-KY(6924-TW)今(8)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年9月營收2.92億元，月增20.45%、年增141倍，主要受惠AI液冷業務進入放量期，CDU（冷卻分配單元）出貨量暢旺，激勵單月、第三季營收7.2億元，創歷史新高，月增39.9%，年增高達80.32%。展望後市，客戶需求強勁，第四季營運樂觀。
榮惠-KY在2026年前9月營收17.07億元，已超越去年全年的16.93億元，年成長34.76%。榮惠-KY2026年前9月的AI伺服器產品營收占比更是加速攀升至11.4%。
榮惠-KY董事長劉世璘表示，客戶追加水冷模組與水冷快速接頭（QD）、感應器、PCBA、板金機殼等相關零組件，加上新開發美系客戶出貨量擴大，站穩伺服器產業擴張浪潮。以地區別來看，日本市場受惠記憶體漲價及需求大增營收翻倍，泰國市場車用基板需求強勁，帶動整體營運走強。
劉世璘表示，公司以AI伺服器液冷供應服務商為核心定位，提供客戶FPC、Rigid-flex、Metal及HDI等多種類基板一站式服務的策略。上半年AI伺服器產品營收占比僅8.2％，3Q 占比逐步攀升，累計前９月提升至11.4％。
展望後市，客戶對水冷模組與零組件加單效應，可望繼續延續，因此本季展望樂觀。此外，鑒於上游玻纖布、樹酯、銅箔基板、記憶體、被動元件等基板原材料成本不斷攀升，將持續對客戶反映轉嫁，迄今已有近九成客戶達到100%轉嫁漲價，有助產業健康發展。
液冷之外，IPC及PCB受惠日本、泰國市場車用基板需求強勁，同步挹注營運成長榮惠第二季毛利率成長至23.2，法人認為，隨著第三季營運規模擴大，毛利率等獲利指標值得期待。
榮惠-KY2026年第二季營收5.15億元，毛利率23.2%，季減3.27個百分點，年增1.42個百分點，稅後純益4234萬元，季減9.2%，年增4.09倍，單季每股純益2.05元。榮惠 – KY在2026年上半年營收9.87億元，毛利率24.77%，年增4.11個百分點，稅後純益8896萬元，年增1.49倍，每股純益4.31元。
paras_en: AI liquid‑cooling and PCB supplier Rong Hui‑KY (6924‑TW) announced on the 8th that its September 2026 revenue was NT$292 million, up 20.45% month‑over‑month and 141‑fold year‑over‑year, driven by AI liquid‑cooling business entering a volume phase and strong shipments of cooling distribution units (CDU). This boosted single‑month and third‑quarter revenue to NT$720 million, a historic high, up 39.9% month‑over‑month and 80.32% year‑over‑year. The company is optimistic for Q4 as customer demand remains strong.

Rong Hui‑KY’s revenue for the first nine months of 2026 totaled NT$1.707 billion, surpassing the full‑year 2025 figure of NT$1.693 billion and representing a 34.76% year‑over‑year increase. The share of AI server product revenue accelerated to 11.4% of total sales for the period.

Chairman Liu Shilin said customers have added water‑cool modules, quick‑disconnect (QD) fittings, sensors, PCBA and metal housings, and shipments to newly developed U.S. customers have expanded, cementing the company’s position in the server industry expansion wave. Regionally, the Japanese market benefited from memory price hikes and a surge in demand, doubling revenue, while strong automotive substrate demand in Thailand also bolstered overall performance.

Liu explained that the company positions itself as a core AI‑server liquid‑cooling supplier, offering a one‑stop service for various substrates such as FPC, rigid‑flex, metal and HDI. AI‑server product revenue accounted for only 8.2% in the first half of the year, rising gradually in Q3 and reaching 11.4% for the first nine months.

Looking ahead, the incremental orders for water‑cool modules and components are expected to continue, making the current‑quarter outlook optimistic. Moreover, rising costs of upstream materials—including glass‑fiber cloth, resin, copper‑foil substrates, memory and passive components—are being passed on to customers; to date nearly 90% of customers have achieved a 100% price pass‑through, supporting healthy industry development.

Beyond liquid cooling, IPC and PCB businesses benefit from strong automotive substrate demand in Japan and Thailand, further fueling operating growth. Rong Hui’s Q2 gross margin rose to 23.2%, and analysts believe that with the expanded scale in Q3, profitability metrics such as margin are worth期待 (expected to improve).

Rong Hui‑KY’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$515 million with a gross margin of 23.2%, down 3.27 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but up 1.42 points year‑over‑year. After‑tax profit was NT$42.34 million, down 9.2% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.09‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding an EPS of NT$2.05. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$987 million, gross margin 24.77% (up 4.11 points YoY), after‑tax profit NT$88.96 million (up 1.49‑fold YoY) and EPS NT$4.31.

items.title: LEO概念股昇達科前9月營收大增71% 重點客戶新一代產品獲順利認證
items.title_en: LEO Concept Stock Shengda Technology Posts 71% Revenue Surge in First Nine Months; Key Customer's Next-Gen Product Gains Smooth Certification
paras: 深耕低軌衛星與毫米波通訊元件的昇達科技(3491-TW)今(8)日公布9月營收，受惠全球低軌衛星(LEO)建置需求持續升溫，公司營運延續強勁成長態勢，單月營收2.92億元，月減9.22%，年增52.49%，值得注意的是，昇達科已連續六個月單月營收年增率超過50%，昇達科今年前三季累計營收27.65億元，年增70.93%，顯示低軌衛星相關產品需求並非單月拉貨效應，而是逐步形成具有延續性的成長趨勢。
從營運基本面來看，低軌衛星仍是推升昇達科成長的主要引擎。隨著既有客戶衛星部署規模持續擴大，公司相關毫米波通訊產品出貨同步成長；另一方面，重點客戶新一代產品認證進展順利，意味昇達科不僅受惠既有世代產品放量，也持續跟進客戶下一世代衛星架構與產品升級，有利於延續後續產品生命周期及訂單能見度。
近期全球LEO產業發展亦持續釋出正向訊號。根據CelesTrak 在10月7日的衛星目錄顯示，全球目前約有1.7萬顆可追蹤的在軌運作衛星（active satellites）；依各業者既有規劃，未來幾年規模可能接近5萬1700顆，接近目前的三倍，而此數據主要反映既有低軌衛星星系的擴張，尚未充分納入近年逐步浮現的太空運算、軌道資料中心等新興應用。
隨著衛星應用由通訊進一步朝資料處理與運算延伸，未來對高頻寬、低延遲及毫米波通訊元件的需求，仍具進一步擴大的可能性。由此顯示全球低軌衛星基礎建設仍處於快速擴張階段。

paras_en: Shengda Technology (3491-TW), which focuses on low‑orbit satellite and millimeter‑wave communication components, announced its September revenue today (the 8th). Benefiting from sustained global demand for low‑orbit satellite (LEO) deployments, the company continued its strong growth trajectory with monthly revenue of NT$292 million, down 9.22% month‑over‑month but up 52.49% year‑over‑year. Notably, Shengda has posted a year‑over‑year monthly revenue growth exceeding 50% for six consecutive months, and its cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year reached NT$2.765 billion, up 70.93% year‑over‑year, indicating that demand for LEO‑related products is not a one‑off shipping surge but a steadily developing growth trend.

From an operational standpoint, low‑orbit satellites remain the primary engine driving Shengda's growth. As existing customers expand their satellite deployment scales, shipments of the company's millimeter‑wave communication products have risen in tandem; meanwhile, progress on certification of a key customer's next‑generation product is proceeding smoothly, meaning Shengda benefits not only from volume increases of current‑generation products but also from following the customer's next‑generation satellite architectures and product upgrades, which supports continued product lifecycle and order visibility.

Recent global LEO industry developments continue to send positive signals. According to CelesTrak’s satellite catalog on October 7, there are currently about 17,000 trackable active satellites in orbit worldwide; based on existing plans from various operators, the total could approach 51,700 satellites in the coming years—nearly three times the current figure. This estimate reflects the expansion of existing low‑orbit satellite constellations and does not yet fully account for emerging applications such as space computing and orbital data centers that have been surfacing in recent years.

As satellite applications move beyond communications toward data processing and computing, future demand for high‑bandwidth, low‑latency millimeter‑wave components is likely to expand further, underscoring that global low‑orbit satellite infrastructure remains in a rapid expansion phase.

It is noteworthy that the LEO industry is shifting from a focus on "new constellation builds" to a new stage where new builds, expansions, and the replacement of existing constellations occur in parallel. In September, Europe’s Eutelsat added another 229 OneWeb satellites, bringing the total number of next‑generation OneWeb satellites it plans to procure from Airbus to 669. In early October, the first batch of 32 new satellites completed production and prepared for launch, which will gradually replace aging satellites and boost constellation capacity and performance. For the supply chain, this means LEO demand is moving from one‑off constellation builds to ongoing replenishment, replacement, and specification upgrades.

Moreover, recent global low‑orbit satellite industry developments continue to emit positive signals. In addition to accelerated deployment and replacement of existing commercial constellations, emerging applications such as AI computing, defense security, and communications resilience are opening a new wave of growth opportunities. In AI, Google successfully launched an experimental satellite equipped with an AI‑processing chip in early October, formally beginning on‑orbit validation of space‑computing technology and showing that satellite use is extending from traditional communications and data transmission to on‑orbit data processing and AI computing. Meanwhile, defense and communications‑resilience needs are also heating up, with Nokia and ICEYE recently announcing a joint development of low‑orbit satellite communications systems for government and defense use; the EU’s IRIS secure satellite communications program has launched its first‑phase satellite development; and the United States continues to advance a distributed military low‑orbit satellite network, reflecting nations’ accelerating integration of satellite communications into national security and critical infrastructure strategies, thereby raising the strategic value of low‑orbit satellites.

Analysts note that the growth momentum of the global low‑orbit satellite industry is evolving from the expansion of existing commercial constellations to further satellite replacement, defense resilience, and AI‑driven applications, driving the satellite communications market toward larger scale, higher performance, and greater reliability.

In this trend, suppliers possessing millimeter‑wave communication technology, high‑frequency precision manufacturing, and stable mass‑production capabilities are poised to capture the demand generated by industry expansion. Shengda has long cultivated millimeter‑wave communication expertise and has entered the international satellite supply chain. With smooth progress on a key customer’s next‑generation product certification and the increasingly diverse applications of low‑orbit satellites attracting more international players to satellite system construction and emerging‑application development, overall market demand is set to keep expanding. Leveraging its existing technology and mass‑production advantages, Shengda can continue to seize multiple business opportunities arising from satellite communication specification upgrades, growing existing‑customer needs, and new‑customer development.

For Shengda, having posted year‑over‑year revenue growth exceeding 50% for six consecutive months in 2026, a 71% year‑over‑year increase for the first three quarters, and smooth certification of a key customer’s next‑generation product, these three indicators respectively reflect "current shipments," "cumulative growth," and "next‑stage product positioning," making the company’s growth momentum more sustainable.

Analysts believe that Shengda’s long‑term focus on millimeter‑wave communication technology and its integration into the international satellite supply chain position it as one of Taiwan’s key suppliers best able to directly capture the expanding demand as the global LEO market moves from scale deployment to replacement and technology upgrades. Ongoing order intake, shipments, and the rollout of next‑generation products merit close monitoring.

paras_en: AI liquid‑cooling and PCB supplier Rong Hui‑KY (6924‑TW) announced on the 8th that its September 2026 revenue was NT$292 million, up 20.45% month‑over‑month and 141‑fold year‑over‑year, driven by AI liquid‑cooling business entering a volume phase and strong shipments of cooling distribution units (CDU). This boosted single‑month and third‑quarter revenue to NT$720 million, a historic high, up 39.9% month‑over‑month and 80.32% year‑over‑year. The company is optimistic for Q4 as customer demand remains strong.

Rong Hui‑KY’s revenue for the first nine months of 2026 totaled NT$1.707 billion, surpassing the full‑year 2025 figure of NT$1.693 billion and representing a 34.76% year‑over‑year increase. The share of AI server product revenue accelerated to 11.4% of total sales for the period.

Chairman Liu Shilin said customers have added water‑cool modules, quick‑disconnect (QD) fittings, sensors, PCBA and metal housings, and shipments to newly developed U.S. customers have expanded, cementing the company’s position in the server industry expansion wave. Regionally, the Japanese market benefited from memory price hikes and a surge in demand, doubling revenue, while strong automotive substrate demand in Thailand also bolstered overall performance.

Liu explained that the company positions itself as a core AI‑server liquid‑cooling supplier, offering a one‑stop service for various substrates such as FPC, rigid‑flex, metal and HDI. AI‑server product revenue accounted for only 8.2% in the first half of the year, rising gradually in Q3 and reaching 11.4% for the first nine months.

Looking ahead, the incremental orders for water‑cool modules and components are expected to continue, making the current‑quarter outlook optimistic. Moreover, rising costs of upstream materials—including glass‑fiber cloth, resin, copper‑foil substrates, memory and passive components—are being passed on to customers; to date nearly 90% of customers have achieved a 100% price pass‑through, supporting healthy industry development.

Beyond liquid cooling, IPC and PCB businesses benefit from strong automotive substrate demand in Japan and Thailand, further fueling operating growth. Rong Hui’s Q2 gross margin rose to 23.2%, and analysts believe that with the expanded scale in Q3, profitability metrics such as margin are worth期待 (expected to improve).

Rong Hui‑KY’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$515 million with a gross margin of 23.2%, down 3.27 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but up 1.42 points year‑over‑year. After‑tax profit was NT$42.34 million, down 9.2% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.09‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding an EPS of NT$2.05. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$987 million, gross margin 24.77% (up 4.11 points YoY), after‑tax profit NT$88.96 million (up 1.49‑fold YoY) and EPS NT$4.31.

In addition to accelerated deployment and replacement of existing commercial constellations, emerging applications such as AI computing, defense security, and communications resilience are opening a new wave of growth opportunities. In AI, Google successfully launched an experimental satellite equipped with an AI‑processing chip in early October, formally beginning on‑orbit validation of space‑computing technology and showing that satellite use is extending from traditional communications and data transmission to on‑orbit data processing and AI computing. Meanwhile, defense and communications‑resilience needs are also heating up, with Nokia and ICEYE recently announcing a joint development of low‑orbit satellite communications systems for government and defense use; the EU’s IRIS secure satellite communications program has launched its first‑phase satellite development; and the United States continues to advance a distributed military low‑orbit satellite network, reflecting nations’ accelerating integration of satellite communications into national security and critical infrastructure strategies, thereby raising the strategic value of low‑orbit satellites.

Analysts note that the growth momentum of the global low‑orbit satellite industry is evolving from the expansion of existing commercial constellations to further satellite replacement, defense resilience, and AI‑driven applications, driving the satellite communications market toward larger scale, higher performance, and greater reliability.

In this trend, suppliers possessing millimeter‑wave communication technology, high‑frequency precision manufacturing, and stable mass‑production capabilities are poised to capture the demand generated by industry expansion. Shengda has long cultivated millimeter‑wave communication expertise and has entered the international satellite supply chain. With smooth progress on a key customer’s next‑generation product certification and the increasingly diverse applications of low‑orbit satellites attracting more international players to satellite system construction and emerging‑application development, overall market demand is set to keep expanding. Leveraging its existing technology and mass‑production advantages, Shengda can continue to seize multiple business opportunities arising from satellite communication specification upgrades, growing existing‑customer needs, and new‑customer development.

For Shengda, having posted year‑over‑year revenue growth exceeding 50% for six consecutive months in 2026, a 71% year‑over‑year increase for the first three quarters, and smooth certification of a key customer’s next‑generation product, these three indicators respectively reflect "current shipments," "cumulative growth," and "next‑stage product positioning," making the company’s growth momentum more sustainable.

Analysts believe that Shengda’s long‑term focus on millimeter‑wave communication technology and its integration into the international satellite supply chain position it as one of Taiwan’s key suppliers best able to directly capture the expanding demand as the global LEO market moves from scale deployment to replacement and technology upgrades. Ongoing order intake, shipments, and the rollout of next‑generation products merit close monitoring.

items.title: 「商總台商騰飛計畫」啟動 許舒博：鏈結資金及資源助台商布局全球
items.title_en: ‘Business Association Taiwan Entrepreneurs Takeoff Plan’ Launched; Xu Shubo: Linking Capital and Resources to Help Taiwanese Businesses Expand Globally
paras: 商業總會為建構全球台商串聯平台，於今(8)日舉辦首屆「商總國際台商騰飛計畫」。理事長許舒博表示，該計畫旨在串聯全球散布各地的僑台商與國內產業鏈，不僅要為海外台商打造強而有力的合作與資金挹注，也期盼能結合日本三井等海外大企業，在海外推「Taiwan Town(台灣城)」的概念，協助大舉外移的高科技人才及連鎖餐飲業開闢出全新的國際據點。
許舒博表示，隨著全球供應鏈加速重組，AI、綠能、智慧製造等新興產業快速發展，海外台商對台灣優勢產業、技術、人才及服務資源的需求也日益增加，商總推出國際台商騰飛計畫(Global Business Turn Up Program)，以「Turn Up」英文的核心理念，協助國內企業與海外台商在國際提升能量、拓展商機，企業發展與人才培育，並將服務範圍從傳統商務交流延伸至產業合作與資源整合。
商總指出，該平台將以台商的實際需求作為策略規劃的出發點，以「平臺、串連、整合」為推動架構，透過「創新、創造、創意」的行動思維，結合商總既有的專業、產業與國際資源，推海外商會交流、商務合作、諮詢輔導、雙向貿易、培訓課程及資源共享等服務。
許舒博強調，讓台商需求與台灣產業優勢能夠有效對接，每年招募50家以上海外台商，與商總國內產業160餘公會從「認識」走向「合作」，從「交流」創造實質商機，計畫將導入「諮詢輔導、資源鏈結、資金導入」等三大核心服務。
經濟部投資促進司長陳愛蘭表示，政府透過「投資台灣三大方案2.0」擴大投資支持，鼓勵全球台商及外商投資，並協助企業推動AI與節能轉型。此次商總提供一條龍整合服務，協助企業加速投資落地，希望深化國際商貿交流與產業合作，開創更多投資與合作商機。
資金支援方面，海外信保基金董事長侯立洋也說明，海外信保長期扮演台商與僑胞最佳後盾，每位僑台商可透過國內外銀行向該基金申請最高銀行授信金額200萬美元的海外信保保證，保證成數將依送保機構及個案風險核定5成-8成，藉由有效分擔銀行的授信風險，大幅提升金融機構的放款意願，希望挹注台商順利取得事業發展資金。
騰飛計畫總召集人陳榮進則表示，海外台商深耕全球，累積豐富的在地市場、人脈與通路資源，台灣擁完整產業鏈、技術、人才與品牌優勢，該計畫未來將透過三資服務，串聯台商力量，從聯誼走向合作、從交流走向商機，讓全球台灣人幫助世界台灣人。
許舒博強調，「商總國際台商騰飛計畫」不僅是台商服務計畫，更是連結台灣與台商的重要橋梁，未來將持續串聯政府、產業、公協會及民間各界力量，透過串聯、資源整合與專業服務，協助臺商掌握全球市場脈動、鏈結臺灣產業優勢，轉化為具體合作與商業成果。
為讓全球台商在國際市場持續「Turn Up」，串起台灣與全球的產業網絡，許舒博也透漏，商總將於今(2026）年底12月17日，在南港展覽館舉辦「2026台灣服務業國際博覽會、世界台商聯合交流合作平台暨商總80周年慶」活動，希望讓台灣中小型企業走向全世界。
paras_en: The Business Association held the inaugural “International Taiwanese Entrepreneurs Takeoff Plan” today (the 8th) to build a global platform linking Taiwanese businesses abroad. Chairman Xu Shubo said the plan aims to connect overseas Taiwanese entrepreneurs with domestic supply chains, providing strong cooperation and capital infusion, and hopes to partner with major overseas firms such as Japan’s Mitsui to promote the concept of “Taiwan Town” abroad, helping high‑tech talent and chain‑restaurant operators relocating overseas establish new international footholds.

Xu explained that as global supply chains are rapidly reshaping and emerging sectors such as AI, green energy, and smart manufacturing expand, overseas Taiwanese entrepreneurs are increasingly seeking Taiwan’s advantages in industry, technology, talent, and services. The Business Association therefore launched the Global Business Turn Up Program, using the core idea of “Turn Up” to help domestic firms and overseas Taiwanese businesses boost capabilities, explore opportunities, develop enterprises and cultivate talent, extending services beyond traditional business exchanges to industrial cooperation and resource integration.

The Association noted that the platform will start from the concrete needs of Taiwanese entrepreneurs, using a “platform‑connect‑integrate” framework. Guided by the action mindset of “innovation, creation, creativity,” it will combine the Association’s existing expertise, industry links, and international resources to offer services such as overseas chamber exchanges, business cooperation, consulting, bilateral trade, training courses, and resource sharing.

Xu emphasized that aligning Taiwanese entrepreneurs’ needs with Taiwan’s industrial strengths is key. The program will recruit more than 50 overseas Taiwanese firms each year and link them with over 160 domestic industry associations, moving from “awareness” to “cooperation” and from “exchange” to tangible business opportunities. It will deliver three core services: consulting, resource linking, and capital introduction.

Minister of the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Investment Promotion Division, Chen Ailan, said the government is expanding investment support through the “Invest Taiwan Three‑Major‑Plans 2.0,” encouraging global Taiwanese and foreign investors and assisting companies in AI and energy‑saving transformations. The Business Association’s one‑stop integrated service will help firms accelerate investment implementation, deepen international trade exchanges and industrial cooperation, and create more investment and partnership opportunities.

Regarding financing, Overseas Credit Insurance Fund Chairman Hou Liyang explained that the fund has long served as a reliable backstop for Taiwanese entrepreneurs and overseas compatriots. Each overseas Taiwanese entrepreneur can apply through domestic or foreign banks for a maximum overseas credit guarantee of US$2 million, with guarantee ratios ranging from 50% to 80% depending on the issuing institution and case risk. By sharing bank credit risk, the fund significantly boosts lenders’ willingness to extend loans, helping entrepreneurs secure development capital.

Program convener Chen Rongjin said overseas Taiwanese entrepreneurs have deep roots worldwide, accumulating rich local market knowledge, networks, and channel resources. Taiwan possesses a complete industrial chain, technology, talent, and brand advantages. The plan will, through three‑service resource integration, link Taiwanese entrepreneurial strength, moving from networking to cooperation and from exchange to business opportunities, enabling Taiwanese people around the globe to help each other.

Xu stressed that the “International Taiwanese Entrepreneurs Takeoff Plan” is not only a service program for Taiwanese businesses but also a vital bridge linking Taiwan with its overseas entrepreneurs. Going forward, the Association will continuously connect government, industry, public‑private associations, and civil society, leveraging networking, resource integration, and professional services to help Taiwanese entrepreneurs grasp global market trends, link Taiwan’s industrial strengths, and translate them into concrete collaborations and commercial results.

To keep global Taiwanese entrepreneurs continuously “Turning Up” in international markets and to weave Taiwan’s industrial network with the world’s, Xu revealed that the Association will hold the “2026 Taiwan Service Industry International Expo, World Taiwanese Entrepreneurs Joint Exchange and Cooperation Platform, and Business Association 80th Anniversary Celebration” on December 17, 2026, at the Nangang Exhibition Hall, aiming to propel Taiwan’s small and medium‑sized enterprises onto the global stage.

items.title: 飛捷9月、Q3營收創同期高 前三季營收超越去年全年
items.title_en: Feijie September, Q3 Revenue Hits Same-Period High, First Three Quarters Revenue Surpasses Last Year Full Year
paras: 工業電腦廠飛捷(6206-TW)今(8)日公告9月營收5.92億元，年增30%，單月營收連續8個月逾5億元第三季營收17.44億元，年增42%，創歷史同期新高；累計前三季營收51.36億元，年增30%，並已超過去年全年的50.33億元。
飛捷說明，前三季區域市場來看，美洲營收年增逾三成，為集團營收成長的主力，其中自今年初於美國NRF展正式推廣的Payment POS支付整合解決方案，單一客戶前三季累計貢獻已突破5億元，成為美洲成長的重要來源。
歐洲市場方面，子公司BOXTEC以英國零售市場為主要動能，今年拓展體育用品及連鎖超市等新客戶；在當地人力短缺的背景下，自助結帳機（Self-checkout）加速導入門市，同時門市數位設備的算力需求提升，帶動Box PC出貨同步增加。
展望後市，飛捷將持續深耕國際大型連鎖餐飲與零售通路，憑藉多樣態端點的設計與製造實力，推動既有客戶升級導入Payment POS等整合機種，加速產品線在客戶門店中的橫向擴張；同時以共用組件設計提升規模效益。新產品除挹注營收外，也成為切入新客戶的契機，同步推動產品組合與客戶組合的優化。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Feijie (6206-TW) announced today (8th) that September revenue was NT$5.92 billion, up 30% year‑over‑year, marking the eighth consecutive month with revenue exceeding NT$5 billion. Q3 revenue was NT$17.44 billion, up 42% year‑over‑year, a historic same‑period high; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$51.36 billion, up 30% year‑over‑year, already exceeding last year’s full‑year total of NT$50.33 billion.

Feijie explained that, by region, revenue in the Americas grew more than 30% year‑over‑year, driving the group’s overall growth. The Payment POS integrated solution, officially launched at the NRF show in the United States earlier this year, has contributed over NT$5 billion from a single customer in the first three quarters, becoming a key source of growth in the Americas.

In Europe, subsidiary BOXTEC is focusing on the UK retail market as its main engine, expanding into new customers such as sporting‑goods retailers and chain supermarkets this year. Amid local labor shortages, self‑checkout machines are being rolled out faster in stores, and the demand for computing power of in‑store digital equipment is rising, boosting shipments of Box PCs.

Looking ahead, Feijie will continue to deepen its presence in large international restaurant and retail chains. Leveraging its versatile endpoint design and manufacturing capabilities, it will encourage existing customers to upgrade to integrated models such as Payment POS, accelerating horizontal expansion of product lines across client stores. At the same time, it will improve scale economies through shared‑component design. New products not only add revenue but also serve as entry points for new customers, driving simultaneous optimization of the product and customer portfolios.

items.title: 利息+手收挹注！彰銀前9月稅後賺173.7億元 EPS達1.44元
items.title_en: Interest and Fees Boost! Chang Hwa Bank Posts NT$17.37 Billion After‑Tax Profit for Jan‑Sep, EPS Reaches NT$1.44
paras: 彰銀今(8)日公布115年9月自結稅後純益18.03億元，年增18.91%，累計前9月累計合併稅後純益173.7億元，年增22.75%，每股稅後純益(EPS)為1.44元，主要受惠於核心業務利息及手續費淨收益表現良好，展現穩定獲利動能。
彰銀持續以「SMART」營運策略推動各項業務發展，以客戶需求為核心，深化數位轉型、財富管理、永續及普惠金融，以科技創新提升客戶服務體驗，並透過綠色存款及綠色授信引導資金投入永續領域。今年於「2026年第23屆國家品牌玉山獎」一舉獲得8項大獎，獲獎領域涵蓋數位金融、智慧支付、普惠金融、綠色金融及高齡金融，展現百年品牌持續創新轉型的成果。
財富管理方面，彰銀持續擴充高資產專家服務團隊，並於今年3月啟動高雄亞灣專區高資產財富管理中心，聚焦槓桿優化、家族傳承及稅務規劃，提供高資產客戶一站式服務；同時深化信託、安養及全齡金融服務，滿足不同生命階段的金融需求。

除營運表現亮眼外，彰銀積極落實公平待客與普惠金融，持續推動「Guardian Star反詐守護星行動計劃」，運用AI及智慧科技強化防詐，並透過失智友善、視障數位服務、偏鄉金融教育及兒少金融教育等措施，擴大金融服務可及性；榮獲金管會公布115 年公平待客原則評核結果前25%銀行業者，已連續2年獲得肯定，同時蟬聯今周刊「最佳公平待客獎」第一名，並獲「最佳普惠金融獎」第三名，另舉辦第四屆公平待客論壇，聚焦AI防詐、風險治理及全齡金融，持續深化公平待客文化。
彰銀表示，未來將持續以客戶需求為核心，深化數位科技與AI應用，拓展財富管理、擴大永續及普惠金融布局，在穩健經營基礎上致力提升獲利動能與品牌價值，提供更智慧、安全、便利且友善的金融服務，朝「亞太優質的國際金融好夥伴，創造智慧金融與永續價值」願景穩健邁進。
paras_en: Chang Hwa Bank announced today (the 8th) that its net profit after tax for September 2023 was NT$1.803 billion, up 18.91% year‑over‑year. For the first nine months, consolidated after‑tax profit totaled NT$17.37 billion, a 22.75% increase, and earnings per share (EPS) were NT$1.44, driven mainly by strong core‑business interest and fee net earnings, reflecting stable profit momentum.

The bank continues to advance its “SMART” operating strategy, putting customer needs at the core while deepening digital transformation, wealth management, sustainability and inclusive finance. Technology innovation is used to enhance customer experience, and green deposits and green loans steer capital toward sustainable projects. This year the bank won eight awards at the 23rd National Brand Yushan Awards 2026, covering digital finance, smart payments, inclusive finance, green finance and senior finance, showcasing the centennial brand’s ongoing innovation and transformation.

In wealth management, Chang Hwa Bank keeps expanding its high‑net‑worth specialist team and launched a high‑net‑worth wealth management center in Kaohsiung’s Asia Bay district in March. The center focuses on leverage optimization, family succession and tax planning, offering one‑stop services for affluent clients. At the same time, the bank deepens trust, senior‑care and all‑age financial services to meet the needs of different life stages.

Beyond strong operating results, the bank actively implements fair‑customer service and inclusive finance. It continues the “Guardian Star Anti‑Fraud Initiative,” using AI and smart technology to strengthen fraud prevention, and expands accessibility through dementia‑friendly, visually‑impaired digital services, rural financial education and youth financial education. The bank ranked in the top 25% of banks in the Financial Supervisory Commission’s 2023 Fair‑Customer Service assessment for the second consecutive year, won first place in the “Best Fair‑Customer Service Award” from This Week Magazine, placed third for the “Best Inclusive Finance Award,” and hosted the 4th Fair‑Customer Forum focusing on AI fraud prevention, risk governance and all‑age finance, further embedding a fair‑customer culture.

Chang Hwa Bank says it will keep customer needs at the core, deepen digital and AI applications, expand wealth management, and broaden its sustainability and inclusive‑finance footprint. Building on a solid operational foundation, it aims to boost profit momentum and brand value, delivering smarter, safer, more convenient and friendly financial services, and steadily moving toward its vision of becoming “a high‑quality international financial partner in Asia‑Pacific, creating smart finance and sustainable value.”

items.title: 工程完工認列挹注大 千附前3季營收38.9億元創歷史高年增近63%
items.title_en: Project completions recognized boost Qianfu Industrial's Q1‑Q3 revenue to NT$3.89 billion, a historic high, with year‑over‑year growth close to 63%
paras: 千附實業(8383-TW)今(8)日公佈9月營收為4.68億元，月減8.42%，年增83.65%，累計2026年1-3季營收達38.9億元，為歷年同期新高。公司表示，受惠全球AI與半導體產業持續擴大資本支出，帶動高階晶圓廠建廠工程、廠務系統及精密零組件需求維持高檔，第三季起廠務工程案件陸續進入完工及營收認列階段，
千附第三季營收14.76億元，年增78.02%。
千附子公司千附精密(6829-TW)第二套「量子電腦超低溫真空腔體設備」也完成出貨並提列挹注，帶動整體營運維持穩健成長。
千附表示，隨著AI、高效能運算（HPC）等應用快速發展，全球半導體大廠持續推進先進製程與先進封裝佈局，相關廠務工程需求亦同步升溫。公司目前廠務工程訂單維持良好能見度，第三季起部分大型專案陸續進入完工認列，預期第四季仍有多項工程案件依進度完成驗收、貢獻營收，持續推升全年營運表現。
另一方面，公司近期更成功取得一家國內大型半導體封裝測試廠之合格供應商資格，預計自今年第四季逐步啟動相關合作，為未來廠務工程業務拓展增添新的成長動能。
千附子公司千附精密持續布局高附加價值市場。除深耕成長中的半導體與光電產業外，在量子電腦領域也穩健推進，8月順利完成第二套設備出貨並認列營收，逐步累積實績。此外，千附精密嘉義馬稠後新廠正按既定進度推進，預計今年底前可取得使用執照。新廠啟用後，將進一步強化半導體精密零組件的製造實力，提前為未來半導體設備及高階製程相關零組件需求做好產能佈局。
展望後市，千附表示，AI浪潮仍持續推升全球半導體產業投資，主要晶圓廠及相關供應鏈資本支出維持擴張趨勢，市場對廠務工程、精密設備及關鍵零組件的需求可望延續，公司除持續掌握既有半導體大廠擴廠商機，亦將透過新客戶供應鏈資格、廠務工程業務拓展及千附精密精密製造能力提升，擴大市場佈局；隨工程案件陸續認列、新廠產能開出，以及航太國防與量子電腦等新興應用持續貢獻，對2027年營運維持穩健成長深具信心。
paras_en: Qianfu Industrial (8383‑TW) announced today (the 8th) that September revenue was NT$468 million, down 8.42% month‑over‑month but up 83.65% year‑over‑year, bringing cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 to NT$3.89 billion – a record high for the same period in history. The company said that continued expansion of capital expenditures in the global AI and semiconductor sectors has kept demand for high‑end wafer‑fab construction projects, plant‑system installations and precision components at a premium level, and that from the third quarter onward plant‑engineering contracts are progressively being completed and recognized as revenue.
Qianfu's third‑quarter revenue was NT$1.476 billion, up 78.02% year‑over‑year.

Qianfu's subsidiary Qianfu Precision (6829‑TW) completed shipment of its second set of "quantum‑computer ultra‑low‑temperature vacuum‑chamber equipment" and recorded the associated revenue, contributing to the company's steady overall growth.

Qianfu noted that as AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) applications develop rapidly, major global semiconductor manufacturers are continuing to advance advanced process and advanced‑packaging roadmaps, which in turn raises demand for related plant‑engineering services. The company currently enjoys good visibility on plant‑engineering orders, with several large projects entering the completion‑recognition stage from the third quarter onward, and expects many more projects to be accepted and to contribute revenue in the fourth quarter, further lifting full‑year performance.

Separately, the company recently secured qualified‑supplier status for a large domestic semiconductor packaging and testing plant, and plans to gradually launch related cooperation from the fourth quarter of this year, adding a new growth engine to its plant‑engineering business expansion.

Qianfu Precision continues to target high‑value‑added markets. In addition to deepening its presence in the growing semiconductor and optoelectronics sectors, it is making steady progress in the quantum‑computer field, having successfully shipped the second set of equipment in August and recognized the revenue, thereby gradually building a track record. Moreover, Qianfu Precision's new plant in Chiayi’s Machou area is progressing on schedule and is expected to obtain its operating license before the end of the year. Once operational, the plant will further strengthen the company's manufacturing capability for semiconductor precision components and position capacity ahead of future demand for semiconductor equipment and advanced‑process parts.

Looking ahead, Qianfu said the AI wave continues to lift global semiconductor investment, with major wafer fabs and related supply‑chain capital spending remaining on an expansion trajectory. Demand for plant‑engineering services, precision equipment and key components is expected to persist. The company will keep capturing expansion opportunities from existing semiconductor giants while also expanding its market reach through new‑customer supply‑chain qualifications, plant‑engineering business development and enhanced precision‑manufacturing capabilities at Qianfu Precision. With engineering projects being recognized, new‑plant capacity coming online, and emerging applications such as aerospace‑defense and quantum computing contributing, the company is confident of maintaining solid growth into 2027.
